svg.title: Hi, I’m Tao — robotics × AI × embedded systems.
svg.desc: An elegant single-line introduction writes itself once, then remains visible.
svg.metadata: Letterforms use EMS Delight, a single-line derivative of Delius by Natalia Raices. The SVG font was created by Sheldon B. Michaels and converted by Windell H. Oskay.
